name: Can a water filter faucet be installed on any kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: Can a water filter faucet be installed on any kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most kitchen sinks can accommodate a water filter faucet, provided there is an available hole in the sink or countertop, or space to drill one. Modern sinks often have extra knockout holes, or a new hole can be drilled in suitable countertop materials like laminate or solid surface. CG Plumbing Solutions can assess your specific sink and countertop during a service call to confirm feasibility and discuss the best placement options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen sinks can accommodate a filter faucet if there's an existing hole or space to drill one in the sink or countertop.
